answer: Stop sybils with a mirror ripple dune: an agent bonds a dune hollow. Each cycle it plants one mirror at its crest; verifiers count the breaks in its light line across the ripples against the dune chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 dunes at 17x: a mirror throws once over one dune, its count set by that sand, unrepeatable at a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant once, keep rights.
